title: Great Knives!
text: Great Knives!. Henckles has been a big name in kitchen cutlery for as long as I can remember. Back when my husband and I were first married, I bought him a single Henckles paring knife for Christmas. They were way out of our price range. He valued that knife for years!! After a few moves, I'm not sure what happened to it. Now we have a full set! The knives are dishwasher safe, but the instructions recommend hand washing. They are sturdy. The handles feel good, though the handle grip could be improved. The knives we've used so far have been very sharp and they cut very well. It's been a while since we've had such sharp knives! The set looks nice on the counter!
